coverage.construction_date_basis: Date the building was 'constructed'; the documents do not say which record (certificate of occupancy or other) is used.
coverage.other_conditions: Mobile home spaces are covered only if offered for rent on or before January 1, 1990.
coverage.summary: Covers residential rental buildings constructed on or before February 1, 1995, and mobile home spaces offered for rent on or before January 1, 1990. Residential buildings constructed after February 1, 1995 and mobile home spaces offered for rent after January 1, 1990 are not covered by the rent cap.
unverifiable_exemptions: Mobile home spaces offered for rent after January 1, 1990

result.notes: Removed supersedes_state_rule=true and the summary's references to Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.12 and the state cap, because none of the documents mention state law. Set requires_unknown_facts to false: the cap applies to ordinary residential rental buildings, limited by a construction-date cutoff. The mobile-home offered-for-rent date cannot be checked from assessor data, so it is listed as an unverifiable exemption. The construction cutoff (on or before 1995-02-01, basis 'constructed', mapped to year_built) is supported by D085.
